experiment.topic: Statistical Validation of Opening Range Breakouts in Crypto Assets (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD) 2019-
experiment.hypothesis: A 20-period opening range breakout with a 3% price threshold on BTC-USD, ETH-USD, and SOL-USD hourly data is statistically more likely to result in a sustained price movement than random noise, given sufficient volume and volatility.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If, over a 12-month period, 80% of opening range breakouts with a 20-period lookback and 3% threshold fail to produce a subsequent 24-hour price move greater than 5% in either direction, the hypothesis is falsified.
